shared: Spiders hide under Lids, unseen and untouchable, then spring with a free strike; staying hidden grows them.
differ: What opens a Lid: a neighbour dying, each spider's own trigger, or a countdown of enemy attacks.

takes.label: Ambush beside the bait
takes.line: Lurkers spring when the unit beside them dies, so it's a seating puzzle: cheap bait beside ambushers, empty gaps around growers.
takes.look_if: a placement puzzle built on neighbours, bait and gaps.

takes.label: Everyone starts hidden
takes.line: Every Lodge spider starts every fight hidden, opened by its own event, like the enemy across attacking; other tribes' units stand guard.
takes.look_if: a board that's all closed doors until the fight.

takes.label: Countdown trapdoors
takes.line: Flip spiders face down while shopping; each Lid springs after a count of enemy attacks; Grand Tyler springs cards from hand.
takes.look_if: to tune when each ambush fires, and hide cards in hand.
